messages:
maria-cs: Crescent seeing intermittent 401s and bursty 429s during SDK init after an edge/WAF rule change. Ticket C-421.
liam-eng: Single host or many? Can you paste a redacted request?
maria-cs: Single host. Example:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}
They report ~1/10 401s and short 429 spikes.
zara-ps: Two quick checks: (1) proxy/WAF may strip/truncate Authorization, (2) very short token TTL causing refresh stampede. TTL?
maria-cs: TTL is 15s, many pre-warmed serverless workers.
sam-sre: Short TTL + sync refresh = fanout and transient 429s. Also proxies can drop Authorization causing 401. Ask them to run a probe with X-Debug-Id.
liam-eng: Probe command:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug-Id:probe" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"probe\"}'
We need raw headers and responses.
maria-cs: Their logs (tokens redacted):
[2026-03-21T09:20:13Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe req=1
[2026-03-21T09:20:13Z] 401 Unauthorized X-Debug-Id=probe req=2 auth=missing
[2026-03-21T09:20:14Z] 429 Too Many Requests X-Debug-Id=probe req=3 rate=client_concurrency
[2026-03-21T09:20:15Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe req=4
sam-sre: That looks like header stripped by WAF/proxy. Any change to CDN/WAF before this started?
maria-cs: Yes, they updated WAF rules right before the failures. They temporarily disabled suspect rules and retried: 10/10 200 and far fewer 429s after adding jitter to refresh.
liam-eng: Action items: (1) fix WAF rule to forward Authorization unchanged, (2) increase token TTL to ~60s and add jitter during onboarding, (3) monitor 429 windows; we can offer a temporary elevated rate window for the ramp.
zara-ps: I'll draft a short onboarding note with nginx/envoy snippets and TTL+jitter guidance.
maria-cs: Updating ticket and asking for WAF post-mortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
